description: This file defines the SaveLeaveEntitlementController class, which manages the process of saving leave entitlements in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for initializing services, preparing data for rendering views, and handling leave entitlement data.

classes.name: SaveLeaveEntitlementController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling the saving of leave entitlement data in the OrangeHRM system. It manages the initialization of related services and the preparation of data for front-end components during rendering.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Returns an instance of LocationService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Returns an instance of CompanyStructureService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares data and components before rendering the view, including fetching leave entitlement details if an ID is provided, and setting properties such as subunits, locations, and leave periods.
